# single.estimate_single_trial_from_dataset { #fmrimod.single.estimate_single_trial_from_dataset }

```python
estimate_single_trial_from_dataset(
    dataset,
    spec,
    *,
    method='lss',
    confounds=None,
    return_se=False,
    block=None,
    durations=None,
    precision=None,
    prewhiten=None,
    nuisance_projector=None,
    chunk_size=None,
    oasis_config=None,
    sbhm_config=None,
    sbhm_library=None,
    include_intercept=False,
    n_basis=None,
    tr=None,
    events=None,
    mask=None,
    slice_timing_offset=None,
)
```

Estimate per-trial betas from an FmriDataset and trialwise spec.

This public-seam wrapper consumes a
`FmriDataset` plus a specification containing a
`trialwise` construction. It builds the trial design matrix
from the specification and dataset events, then delegates to
`estimate_single_trial`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Default    |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| dataset            | FmriDataset or image source                                    | Typed dataset carrying time-series data and an event table, or an image source (NIfTI path/image, per-run list, array) together with ``tr=``, ``events=`` and optionally ``mask=`` / ``slice_timing_offset=``, as in `fmrimod.fmri_lm`.                                                                                                                                                   | _required_ |
| spec               | trialwise() term, Spec, str, list of Term or EventModelBuilder | Trialwise specification. Accepts whatever `fmrimod.event_model` accepts: a string formula such as ``"trialwise()"`` or ``"trialwise(add_sum=True)"``, a list of `Term` objects, or a builder. A typed `fmrimod.spec.trialwise` term (or a ``Spec`` holding only event terms) is also accepted and lowered through `fmrimod.spec.compile_events`. | _required_ |
| method             | SingleTrialMethod or literal string                            | Estimator selector; see `estimate_single_trial`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `'lss'`    |
| confounds          | NDArray\[np.float64\] \| None                                  | oasis_config, sbhm_config, sbhm_library, include_intercept Forwarded to `estimate_single_trial`. When ``prewhiten.runs`` is unset it is filled from the dataset's sampling-frame runs; supplied runs must match the frame's run boundaries.                                                                                                                                               | `None`     |
| return_se          | NDArray\[np.float64\] \| None                                  | oasis_config, sbhm_config, sbhm_library, include_intercept Forwarded to `estimate_single_trial`. When ``prewhiten.runs`` is unset it is filled from the dataset's sampling-frame runs; supplied runs must match the frame's run boundaries.                                                                                                                                               | `None`     |
| prewhiten          | NDArray\[np.float64\] \| None                                  | oasis_config, sbhm_config, sbhm_library, include_intercept Forwarded to `estimate_single_trial`. When ``prewhiten.runs`` is unset it is filled from the dataset's sampling-frame runs; supplied runs must match the frame's run boundaries.                                                                                                                                               | `None`     |
| nuisance_projector | NDArray\[np.float64\] \| None                                  | oasis_config, sbhm_config, sbhm_library, include_intercept Forwarded to `estimate_single_trial`. When ``prewhiten.runs`` is unset it is filled from the dataset's sampling-frame runs; supplied runs must match the frame's run boundaries.                                                                                                                                               | `None`     |
| chunk_size         | NDArray\[np.float64\] \| None                                  | oasis_config, sbhm_config, sbhm_library, include_intercept Forwarded to `estimate_single_trial`. When ``prewhiten.runs`` is unset it is filled from the dataset's sampling-frame runs; supplied runs must match the frame's run boundaries.                                                                                                                                               | `None`     |
| block              | object                                                         | Forwarded to `fmrimod.event_model`. ``block`` and ``durations`` default to event-table column auto-detection (``run``/``block`` and ``duration``).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `None`     |
| durations          | object                                                         | Forwarded to `fmrimod.event_model`. ``block`` and ``durations`` default to event-table column auto-detection (``run``/``block`` and ``duration``).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `None`     |
| precision          | object                                                         | Forwarded to `fmrimod.event_model`. ``block`` and ``durations`` default to event-table column auto-detection (``run``/``block`` and ``duration``).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|--------|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | SingleTrialResult | Carries ``trial_labels`` derived from the trialwise term column names plus dataset-derived metadata: ``trial_table`` (the events slice aligned with ``betas`` rows), ``run_labels`` (per-trial block/run id when the events table carries one), ``subject_id`` (when the dataset advertises one), and ``spatial_descriptor`` (the capability label describing the voxel space the betas live in). Matrix-first `estimate_single_trial` callers continue to leave all four metadata fields ``None``. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

One LSS beta map per trial, straight from images:

```pycon
>>> from fmrimod.spec import trialwise
>>> betas = fm.estimate_single_trial_from_dataset(
...     img, trialwise(), tr=2.0, events=events, mask=mask,
...     method="lss", include_intercept=True,
... )
>>> betas.betas.shape          # (n_trials, n_voxels)
```
